name: reader-core
note: Local pin ahead of upstream: carries the 0.2.1 patches (on-device voices only, no network/browser-default fallback, refusal via opts.onNoLocalVoice; caller-supplied synchronous storage adapter via opts.storage) plus the 0.3.0 paragraph navigation — paragraph map, read-from-here gestures, scrubbable seek bar, previous/next paragraph, read-this-only ranges, follow-along scroll, and voice-picker plumbing (opts.voiceURI, setVoice/getVoices). Pending upstream as 0.3.0. Plus the 2026-11-07 sentence-start fix: pointed starts (right-click / long-press / read-from-here via seekFromNode) begin at the sentence under the point, with the paragraph as fallback. Plus the 2026-11-07 retest fixes: a pointed start whose hit target is the paragraph element resolves by press-point geometry to the sentence on the point's line (seekFromNode opts.point; the extension passes its tracked contextmenu point; inline wrappers of a single sentence resolve to it directly), and playSelection falls back to the last selection observed inside the reader when the live selection is already gone (the touch tap-collapse case). The hashes above pin the bytes exactly as shipped. Plus the 0.4.0 voice-pack seam (2026-11-07): create() accepts opts.synth + opts.UtteranceCtor (the speaker.js injection shape), defaulting to the platform speechSynthesis, so a shell's own on-device speech transport can drive the reader; without the option, behaviour is byte-for-byte 0.3.0's. The hashes above pin the bytes exactly as shipped. Plus the 2026-11-10 skip-notice seam (same 0.4.0 line): opts.onChunkSkipped fires once per reader when an utterance error carries the transport's ladderExhausted mark, so a chunk skipped after the voice pack's synthesis recovery ladder is exhausted is announced by the shell instead of passing silently.
